verdict.rationale: Secureframe's built-in Comply AI performs specific tasks inside the product. It automates risk assessments (inherent and residual scores, treatment, justifications), drafts and revises policies, extracts vendor security-review answers from SOC 2 reports, generates SSPs and POA&Ms, and auto-generates infrastructure-as-code fixes. These are fixed, feature-bound automations rather than a general in-product assistant that takes open-ended delegated tasks. The MCP server serves external assistants, so it is not credited as built-in. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant or chat agent that accepts arbitrary delegated tasks, documentation of multi-step agentic task execution within the app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
